sentiment: What is broken is not lost; patience turns the smallest wheel until the whole room keeps time again.

stories.title: Claude discovers a novel enzyme system with CRISPR-like repeats
stories.summary: A new enzyme system found by an artificial collaborator. Discovery is not only the flash of finding — it is the long, patient arrangement of parts until something hidden finally lines up.

stories.title: Fixing the Portobello Police Station Clock
stories.summary: A stopped public clock is coaxed back to keeping time. Repair is a kind of care that refuses to accept broken as final — small brass wheels, adjusted one at a time.

stories.title: ArXiv receives multiyear commitments to support it as an independent nonprofit
stories.summary: Shared infrastructure kept alive by quiet, long commitments. The archive does not shout; it just keeps the record intact so the next mind can find its hour.
